commits.subject: reel + reel-native (SMB-REEL-BFRAME-ORDER): presentation-order picture matching; H.264 B-frames decode exactly

capabilities_done: reel: VideoDecodeSession::reorders_output() (default false, so AV1 in-process/worker, VC-3 and ProRes keep decode-order matching unchanged). Matching rule when a session declares it: Forward finds the pending packet whose index equals the picture tag, removes only that entry, and drops the pending packets whose pts is BEFORE the picture's pts (presentation-order rule: the decoder has passed them, their pictures were dropped or carry no frame); packets decoded earlier but presented later (B-frame references, pre-roll P after the range) stay pending. Pictures reach the sink in presentation order. Partial receipts unchanged in rule: actual span = earliest pts .. latest pts+duration over delivered pictures, units = delivered

reel test pictures_released_in_presentation_order_are_matched_by_tag (tests/video_route.rs, fake decoder releasing in a given tag order, I P B clip): 8 rows - declared release 0,2,1 as it goes and held until finish (all 3 delivered in presentation order, receipt == packet receipt); control without the declaration (P lost, Partial, span 0..40); DropPicture 0/1/2 (Partial, spans of delivered pictures); range = B alone with I and P as pre-roll (complete, 20..40); release P before B (B passed over, Partial)

reel-native host: decode_order_only/last_tag guard removed; OpenPlan/WorkerSession carry reorders_output (MF true, AV1 false) reported through VideoDecodeSession::reorders_output; replay de-duplicates by the SET of delivered tags (kept only when replay is on, bounded by the segment's packets) instead of 'tag <= last delivered'

reel-native MF worker: waiting = HashSet of sent tags whose picture is owed; a picture may be any of them (presentation order); unknown or already-released time -> Unsupported mf-output-time-unknown; refusal mf-reorder-needs-packet-timing and pub const MF_REORDER_REFUSAL removed (wire table string kept, commented retired, indices unchanged)

notes.matching_rule: reorders_output false: picture -> pending entry with index == tag; drain every entry up to and including it (unchanged). reorders_output true: remove that entry only; retain pending entries with pts >= picture pts. A picture whose entry is gone (already matched or passed over) is not delivered; the shortfall shows in units/complete/Partial span. Equal-pts entries are retained (bounded by the segment's packets).
notes.accuracy_vs_ffmpeg: EXACT, no tolerance: high-bf2, main-bf3, high-bf3-pyramid 24/24 each, software and DXVA; 21 random-access ranges exact; replay exact
residuals: R1 replay retention resets at each sync packet: a crash exactly at an IDR packet loses pictures the dead decoder still held from the previous GOP (B-frame streams hold the last reference until bumped); they are reported (Partial / Incomplete), never silent. Not exercised; a fix would retain from the previous sync packet until every owed picture before the IDR was released
